verdict.rationale: Dots is itself a built-in, always-on agent inside ChatGPT. The docs say you can hand it tasks, keep talking to it while it works, and it returns results or decisions. It can run background agents in parallel and delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex, with that delegated work inspectable in Activity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as documented, since all evidence is vendor docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Your dot is an always-on agent that keeps work moving across your tools and projects. You can keep talking to it while it works, and it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
It can use background agents to work on several things in parallel while you keep talking to it.
Your dot can delegate parts of a request to ChatGPT Work or Codex. In the desktop app, open your dot's profile and select Activity to inspect delegated work
ask it to investigate new bug reports in a connected Slack channel and prepare fixes for your review.
